    Sabrina Carpenter is scheduled to headline the Coachella Stage on Friday, April 10, and Friday, April 17, 2026. Her set begins at 9:05 p.m. PDT and runs for 90 minutes until 10:35 p.m. PDT, with the show available to stream on the official Coachella YouTube channel. 
    • Date: Friday, April 10 (Weekend 1) and Friday, April 17 (Weekend 2).
    • Time: 9:05 p.m. – 10:35 p.m. PDT.
    • Stage: Coachella Main Stage.
    • Livestream: Available on YouTube. 
    Her performance is positioned as a primary act on the main stage, leading into the late-night acts.
